reason: Both conversations missed the real meaning of Er03 (liquid/object on the touch controls) and both over-prescribed a 24-hour isolation instead of simply advising 'wipe the control panel dry and power cycle', then both sensibly stood down once the homeowner reported it working. Conversation 1 at least framed the code as moisture/overheat detection and described the recovery as a transient trigger, giving a reassuring and accurate close. Conversation 2 admitted the code was not in its database yet still asserted a 'short circuit or earth fault' and raised PCB replacement, an unsupported and more alarming diagnosis that was never corrected in the follow-up, where it still hinted at a 'deeper electrical fault'.
